Dear [Opposing Counsel's Name],

We appreciate your feedback on the revised draft of the Confidential Settlement Agreement. In response to your request for adjustments to the indemnification clause and confidentiality terms, we have made the following revisions to better align with our mutual interests:

1. Expanded the confidentiality clause to encompass broader disclosures that aim to uphold both parties' interests.

Best regards,  
[Your Name]  
Aldous Finch LLP
